verdict.rationale: OpenTofu describes infrastructure in a declarative configuration syntax and human-readable configuration files, not a general-purpose programming language. Its for_each looping is a feature of that configuration language, so it is adjacent rather than the capability the story asks for. Evidence on IDE support points the other way: a community member could not find any language-server repository in the project.

support.subject: As a developer, I can define infrastructure in a general-purpose programming language with types, loops, and IDE support
